name: HSSE
description: Malaysian statutory HSSE duties, the RM20 million SHO threshold, EIA applicability to Sabah, and ISO management-system editions with a preserved conflict between ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 14001:2026.

specifications.metric: Safety and Health Officer (SHO) statut — project contract price threshold making SHO appointment mandatory for builders
specifications.basis: DOSH 'Petunjuk Prestasi SHO / SHO Performance Indicators' page read 25 Nov 2026, 'Updated Date: 16/03/2026': 'The appointment of an SHO is encouraged among client companies and designers, but mandatory for builders if the construction work has a total project contract price exceeding RM20 million.' Regulation 12 of the Safety and Health Officer Regulations 1997 allows DOSH to refuse renewal of SHO

vendor_models.line: Safety and Health Officer (SHO) statutory appointment

gaps.why: No project-specific HSSE budget, incident statistics, HSE plan or ISO 45001/14001 certificate for the 7-unit plant was found. The EIA Order 2015 text read has no explicit gas-engine-plant entry, so its applicability to this plant is not established.
gaps.next_action: Confirm EIA classification with DOE Sabah, and obtain the contractor's HSSE plan and certification evidence before pricing.
